items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: the big thing about that concert was Freddie Robbins was a disc jockey who was running a thing

ctx.x: no Bobby Hackett and Peanuts well you know Sidney was supposed to be on that no I don't remember that in fact the big thing about that concert was Freddie Robbins was a disc jockey who was running a thing and he had every night in the program for a couple of weeks before the concert he talked about this reunion Sidney Boucher and Louis Armstrong that was the big thing about it
